visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a vibrant close-up of a prepared cold dish featuring green water lily stalks and white enoki mushrooms, topped with sesame seeds. A person's hand uses chopsticks to lift a portion. Various text overlays in Chinese appear against a brightly lit kitchen background with a red pot. (2) Transitioning to food preparation, a pair of hands cleans a long bundle of green water lily stalks in a kitchen sink. The setting is bright and clean. The stalks are then wound into a large circular shape on a yellow cutting board. A sharp knife is used to cut off the ends and chop them into uniform segments. (3) The scene shifts to preparing enoki mushrooms. The hands cut open a plastic package, wash the mushrooms in a stainless steel bowl to remove debris, and then squeeze them dry with a twisting motion. The mushrooms are placed on the cutting board and sliced in half. A red pot is visible in the background. (4) A carrot is peeled directly into a metal bowl containing the prepared water lily segments. The lighting is soft and natural. Next, a pot of water on a stovetop is seasoned with salt from a small ceramic jar. The steam rises as enoki mushrooms are added to the boiling water and stirred with chopsticks. (5) The water lily and carrot shreds are added to the pot with the mushrooms. A wooden spatula is used to stir the mixture. After boiling, the vegetables are transferred to a metal strainer over a bowl to drain. The camera remains in a medium close-up, focusing on the textures and colors of the food. (6) In a metal mixing bowl, the cooked vegetables are tossed with chopsticks. A bottle of sesame dressing is squeezed over the food, followed by a drizzle of perilla oil from a glass bottle. Sesame seeds are sprinkled from a wooden spoon. The hands mix everything thoroughly to ensure even coating. (7) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a pink apron, is shown sitting at a wooden table. She uses chopsticks to eat a large mouthful of the salad, showing an expression of intense enjoyment. She gives a thumbs up and holds up the empty plate, smiling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 簡單、快速小菜❤. [Subtitle]: 溫拌水蓮金針菇. [Variety]: 好吃到停不下來. (2) [Subtitle]: 水蓮 浸泡清洗乾淨. (3) [Subtitle]: 繞成一個大圈圈. (4) [Subtitle]: 先把蒂頭切掉. (5) [Subtitle]: 先切開一刀. (6) [Subtitle]: 再依序切成等長. (7) [Subtitle]: 取下橡皮筋. (8) [Subtitle]: 放入調理盆中. (9) [Subtitle]: 金針菇 切開包裝. (10) [Subtitle]: 清洗掉木屑. (11) [Subtitle]: 擠乾水分. (12) [Subtitle]: 將金針菇對半切. (13) [Subtitle]: 喜歡金針菇多一點 可以切兩包. (14) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔刨些絲 約三分之一根. (15) [Subtitle]: 煮一鍋水 水裡加入足夠的鹽. (16) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後放入金針菇 煮一分鐘. (17) [Subtitle]: 水蓮、紅蘿蔔絲 煮40~50秒. (18) [Subtitle]: 立刻撈起 瀝掉水分. (19) [Subtitle]: 水分要瀝乾喔，不然吃起來會水水的. (20) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜放入盆子裡. (21) [Subtitle]: 拌入芝麻沙拉醬. (22) [Subtitle]: 拌入韓國紫蘇油 風味更佳！ (23) [Subtitle]: 一點芝麻粒. (24) [Subtitle]: 拌一拌. (25) [Slogan]: 簡單、快速小菜❤. [Subtitle]: 溫拌水蓮金針菇. (26) [Variety]: 超好吃又簡單. (27) [Variety]: 我一個人都可以吃掉一大盤❤. (28) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.
